description_en: Queries the list of resource groups
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager list-resource-groups --status OK --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --resource-group-id rg-9gLOoK0000 --display-name my-project --name my-project --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --include-tags false --resource-group-ids rg-1hSBH20000_,_rg-9gLOoK0000 --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResourceGroups

parameters.help_en:
The resource group status. This parameter is used as a filter condition. Valid values:

Creating: The resource group is being created.
OK: The resource group is created.
PendingDelete: The resource group is pending deletion
parameters.help_zh:
资源组状态，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

Creating：创建中。
OK：创建成功。
PendingDelete：等待删除
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID. This parameter is used as a filter condition.

The value cannot exceed 18 characters in length and must start with `rg-`.

This parameter has been incorporated into the ResourceGroupIds parameter. If you set both ResourceGroupId and ResourceGroupIds, the value of ResourceGroupIds takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID，用于查询的过滤条件。

长度不能超过18个字符，且以`rg-`开头。

该参数已被收编到参数`ResourceGroupIds`，如果您同时设置了`ResourceGroupId`和`ResourceGroupIds`，则会以`ResourceGroupIds`为准
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The display name of the resource group. This parameter is used as a filter condition. Fuzzy match is supported.

The value cannot exceed 50 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
资源组显示名称，用于查询的过滤条件。支持模糊查询。

长度不能超过50个字符
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the resource group. This parameter is used as a filter condition. Fuzzy match is supported.

The value cannot exceed 50 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
资源组唯一标识，用于查询的过滤条件。支持模糊查询。

长度不能超过50个字符，可包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The tags. This parameter is used as a filter condition.

You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh:
标签，用于查询的过滤条件。

最多可以设置20个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return tag information. Valid values:

false (default): Tag information is not returned.

true: Tag information is returned.
If you specify tag-based filter conditions, tag information is always returned regardless of the value of IncludeTags
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回标签信息。取值：

false（默认值）：不返回。

true：返回。
当您设置了标签过滤条件后，不论`IncludeTags`为何值，都会返回标签信息
parameters.name: include_tags

parameters.help_en:
The list of resource group IDs. This parameter is used as a filter condition.

You can specify up to 100 resource group IDs.

If you set both ResourceGroupId and ResourceGroupIds, the value of ResourceGroupIds takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID列表，用于查询的过滤条件。

最多可以设置100个资源组ID。

如果您同时设置了`ResourceGroupId`和`ResourceGroupIds`，则会以`ResourceGroupIds`为准
parameters.name: resource_group_ids

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页时每页显示的数据条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that match the conditional request parameter criteria
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合请求参数条件的数据总条数
